method: Documented historical diplomatic and security events, not automatically influence outcomes. Distinguish agreement, allegation, legal breach, implementation and economic consequences.

cases.event: Australia, UK and US announced AUKUS security partnership; French submarine contract cancellation was a separate Australian decision.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Verify delivered capabilities, costs, alliance friction and regional deterrence outcomes.

cases.event: U.S. completed military withdrawal from Afghanistan; Afghan government collapsed during withdrawal.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Compare regional access, security costs, partner trust and independently measured influence.

cases.event: Russia launched full-scale invasion of Ukraine; UN General Assembly demanded Russian withdrawal.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure sanctions, territorial control, costs, alliance changes and trade diversion independently.

cases.event: EU prohibition on Russian coal imports took effect following April 2022 sanctions package.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Compare origin-specific physical energy flows, costs and substitutions.
Measure alliance capabilities, defense expenditure and Russia's response, without treating membership as numeric influence.

cases.event: India, US, EU and partners announced an economic corridor memorandum; announcement did not establish a completed transport route.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Verify financing, construction, trade throughput and competing route effects.
Measure force posture and realized security outcomes.

cases.event: EU 14th sanctions package included restrictions on transshipment of Russian LNG in EU ports, subject to transition; not a general ban on EU Russian LNG imports.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure affected volumes, enforcement and price changes.
